# STEP 4: Cell detection and tracking

def detect_cells_simple(img, threshold_sigma=2.5, min_area_px=30):
    """Simple threshold-based cell detection."""
    img = img.astype(float)
    img_norm = (img - img.mean()) / (img.std() + 1e-7)
    binary = img_norm > threshold_sigma
    labeled, num_features = ndimage.label(binary)
    
    centroids = []
    for cell_id in range(1, num_features + 1):
        cell_mask = labeled == cell_id
        area_px = np.sum(cell_mask)
        if area_px >= min_area_px:
            coords = np.where(cell_mask)
            cy = np.mean(coords[0])
            cx = np.mean(coords[1])
            centroids.append((cy, cx))
    
    return centroids

            next_cell_id += 1
    else:
        prev_ids = list(cell_assignments.keys())
        prev_centroids = [cell_assignments[cid] for cid in prev_ids]
        
        if len(prev_ids) > 0 and len(current_centroids) > 0:
            n_prev = len(prev_ids)
            n_curr = len(current_centroids)
            cost_matrix = np.full((n_prev, n_curr), MAX_TRACKING_DIST + 1, dtype=float)
            
            for i, prev_id in enumerate(prev_ids):
                prev_cy, prev_cx = prev_centroids[i]
                for j, (cy, cx) in current_centroids.items():
                    dist = np.sqrt((cy - prev_cy)**2 + (cx - prev_cx)**2)
